source.text: A 67-year-old man presented with cough. Biopsy confirmed lung adenocarcinoma. The lung cancer was documented as stage IV with liver metastasis. Tumor testing was positive for EGFR exon 19 deletion. Osimertinib 80 mg orally daily was started for the lung cancer. He reported no known drug allergies. His mother had breast cancer. He previously smoked cigarettes and stopped 10 years ago. At three-month follow-up, the cough had improved.
